What is the photo for?

Scanning helps copy the details from your document into the form. You can type them in by hand instead.

In this demo the camera only shows the image on your screen: no photo is saved or sent. If you do not allow access, a simulation is used. In the real product, this section must show the data processing and retention information agreed with the property.

End of the prototype: the details we read appear in the form.
